blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Route planning is choosing which roads, and in which order, to make the most stops in the least time. A driver with twenty deliveries can take them in a bad order and sit in traffic all day, or in a good order and finish by lunchtime.

A few simple rules help. Group your stops by neighbourhood. Don't double back on the same road. Plan for traffic. And leave a small buffer for surprises.

Software can plan a route faster, but the logic is the same. A few minutes of planning in the morning saves hours of driving in the afternoon.

items.q: What is route planning?
options: Choosing which roads and order to use for deliveries
items.why: "Route planning is choosing which roads, and in which order…"

items.q: What happens if the driver takes the stops in a bad order?
options: He sits in traffic all day
items.why: "…in a bad order and sit in traffic all day."

items.q: Which is one of the simple rules in the text?
items.why: "Group your stops by neighbourhood."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: Planning in the morning is a waste of time
A good order saves hours of driving
Doubling back is a bad idea
A small buffer helps with surprises
items.why: Inferência: o texto inteiro diz que planejar de manhã economiza horas — ele não concordaria que é perda de tempo.

items.q: The text suggests that software…
options: uses the same logic, only faster
items.why: Inferência: "Software can plan a route faster, but the logic is the same."

blocks.instruction: Ouça Harry conversando com o novo planejador. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning. Come and sit down. Let's look at yesterday's routes together.

Here is the map. Look at these three stops. This one is in the north, this one is in the south, and this one is in the north again. So the driver went north, then south, then back north. That is doubling back. It wastes a lot of time and fuel.

The rule is simple. Group your stops by neighbourhood. Do all the north stops first, then move to the south. Don't go back and forth.

Also, always leave a small buffer. Yesterday there was heavy traffic on the bridge at four o'clock, and the driver had no extra time. So the last two deliveries were late.

You did a good job on the other stops, so don't worry. Just remember two things for today. Group by neighbourhood, and plan for traffic. A few minutes here in the morning saves us hours in the afternoon. Let's plan today's route now, together.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What are Harry and the planner looking at?
items.why: "Let's look at yesterday's routes together."

items.q: Why was going north, then south, then north again a problem?
options: It was doubling back and wasted time and fuel
items.why: "That is doubling back. It wastes a lot of time and fuel."

items.q: Why were the last two deliveries late?
options: There was heavy traffic and no buffer time
items.why: "there was heavy traffic on the bridge… the driver had no extra time."

items.q: How does Harry feel about the new planner's work?
options: He thinks the planner should quit
Generally positive, with two things to improve
He does not care about the routes
items.why: Inferência: "You did a good job on the other stops… Just remember two things." Ele corrige com bom tom.

items.q: What does Harry believe about morning planning?
options: A few minutes in the morning saves hours later
It should be done by software only
It should take the whole morning
items.why: Inferência: "A few minutes here in the morning saves us hours in the afternoon."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The driver has twenty stops on his route today." A route is…
options: the path he drives to make deliveries
items.why: Route = rota: o caminho das entregas.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Let's group the deliveries by ___, so we don't drive across the city many times."
items.why: Neighbourhood = bairro. Agrupar por bairro evita cruzar a cidade.

items.q: "We always leave a small buffer in the schedule." A buffer is…
items.why: Buffer = margem: um tempo extra para imprevistos.

items.q: Choose the correct phrase: "Don't ___ on the same road — it wastes time."
items.why: To double back = voltar pelo mesmo caminho, um dos maiores desperdícios de tempo.

items.q: "Good planning helps us save time." To save time means to…
items.why: To save time = economizar tempo, usar menos tempo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões de logística. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the new route plan." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "We will roll out the new planning software next month." To roll out means to…
options: start using it step by step
items.why: Roll out = colocar em uso de forma progressiva.

items.q: "Two drivers pushed back on the new route." They…
items.why: Push back on = resistir, discordar.

items.q: "We made a plan, but the team did not follow through." They…
options: did not finish what they planned
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado.

items.q: "Grouping stops by neighbourhood really moves the needle on delivery time." This means it…
items.why: Move the needle = mexer o ponteiro, fazer diferença perceptível.
